title: Fourier coefficient sum over label tuples
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ have all its nonzero Fourier coefficients supported on subsets of size $k$. Then the sum, over all maps $a:[k]\to[n]$, of the squared Fourier coefficient indexed by the image of $a$ is at most $k!$ times the total squared Fourier weight of $f$ on subsets of size $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is indexed by a subset of size $k$
